messages.content: Hi, this is Dana Whitfield. I’d like to move my Thursday appointment with Dr. Patel to next week, preferably in the mornings if possible.
Can you please provide your date of birth to verify your identity?
My name is Dana Whitfield, and my date of birth is March 14, 1978.
Your appointment with Dr. Patel has been successfully moved to next week on September 14th at 9:00 AM. Is there anything else I can help you with?
I prefer a morning appointment, but I can’t do Monday because I work then.
Your appointment has been rescheduled to Tuesday, September 15th at 9:30 AM. Is there anything else you need?
[direction] Say that is everything and thank them. End the call politely.

response.text: That’s everything, thank you! Have a great day!
